nodes.label: AudioFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping audio-primary formats: Song, SoundEffect.

nodes.label: HistoricalEvent
nodes.comment: A historical event, period, or crisis referenced by a meme.

nodes.label: ImageManipulationFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping image manipulation formats: Exploitable, ImageMacro, Photoshop, Remix.

nodes.label: MediaProperty
nodes.comment: A media franchise, film, TV series, game, or other creative property referenced by a meme.

nodes.label: NarrativeFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping character- and narrative-based formats: Character, FanArt, Parody, PopCultureReference, Reaction.

nodes.label: ParticipatoryFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping participatory formats: ParticipatoryMedia, Dance, SocialGame.

nodes.label: PoliticalEvent
nodes.comment: A political event, controversy, or campaign that a meme iconologically references.

nodes.label: PublicFigure
nodes.comment: A public figure, celebrity, politician, or historical person referenced by a meme.

nodes.label: SocialPhenomenon
nodes.comment: A social movement, behavioural trend, or cultural practice referenced by a meme.

nodes.label: TextFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping text-based formats: Catchphrase, Copypasta, Slang, Snowclone, Hashtag.

nodes.label: VideoFormat
nodes.comment: MemeFormat subclass grouping video-based formats: ViralVideo, ViralDebate, LipDub.

nodes.label: WebCulture
nodes.comment: A web-native cultural phenomenon, community, or trend referenced by a meme.

nodes.label: Book
nodes.comment: Book, novel or short story from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: ComicBook
nodes.comment: Comic strip, webcomic or graphic novel from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: Movie
nodes.comment: Film from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: MusicAlbum
nodes.comment: Song, album or music video from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: TvSeries
nodes.comment: Television or web series from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: VideoGame
nodes.comment: Video game from which the meme derives; subclass of wd:Q386724.

nodes.label: FileFormat
nodes.comment: Digital file format of the meme image resource; aligned with Wikidata Q235557.

nodes.label: TimePeriod
nodes.comment: Chronological period in which the meme originated or peaked; aligned with Wikidata Q11471.

nodes.label: OriginPlatform
nodes.comment: Online platform or service where the meme was first published; aligned with Wikidata Q3220391.

nodes.label: GeographicRegion
nodes.comment: Geographic region or country of meme origin; aligned with Wikidata Q82794.

nodes.label: AnimationStatus
nodes.comment: Whether a meme image is animated (Animated, i.e. a GIF) or static (Static). Derived from file extension.

nodes.label: ImageType
nodes.comment: The visual medium or rendering technique of a meme image (e.g. Photograph, Drawing, Cartoon). Corresponds to Panofsky's pre-iconographic description.

nodes.label: SubjectMatter
nodes.comment: The primary visual subject category depicted in a meme image (e.g. PersonPresent, AnimalPresent, ObjectOnly). Corresponds to Panofsky's pre-iconographic description level.

nodes.label: TransformationDimension
nodes.comment: The primary dimension along which a VariantInstance transforms the source template (e.g. textual, visual, contextual). Enables typological analysis of meme variation.

nodes.label: TransformationExtent
nodes.comment: The degree to which a VariantInstance diverges from its source template (e.g. Minimal, Moderate, Major). Enables quantitative analysis of meme mutation.

nodes.label: MemeIdea
nodes.comment: The abstract creative idea underlying a meme template; the Work level of the FRBR hierarchy. Represents the core concept, emotional register, or rhetorical function of a meme, independent of any specific image or format.

nodes.label: CulturalReference
nodes.comment: Cultural artefact, event, or phenomenon that a meme iconologically references; aligned with Wikidata Q96622155.

nodes.label: MemeFormat
nodes.comment: The genre or structural format of a meme (e.g. ImageMacro, Copypasta, ViralVideo). Drawn from Know Your Meme's type taxonomy.

nodes.label: OriginWork
nodes.comment: Creative work (film, TV series, game, etc.) from which the meme derives; aligned with Wikidata Q386724.

nodes.label: VariantInstance
nodes.comment: A specific image derived from a meme template; the Manifestation level of the FRBR hierarchy. Represents a single scraped or documented instantiation of a MemeConcept.

nodes.label: MemeConcept
nodes.comment: A meme template or canonical format; the Expression level of the FRBR hierarchy. Represents the stable, recognisable form of a meme as documented on Know Your Meme.
